name: com.gi.entities
description: Sparse tiled integer influence fields for Unity Entities.

samples.description: Agents that splat noise and steer up the gradient of a derived layer toward goals.
Two teams of persistent emitters, a Mask layer for the contested border, banner probes.
Vision-cone guards, a noisy player, run pulses, and a Nearest binding that wakes them.
A game job reading the field directly through GiFrame behind the read fence.
